verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Copilot Chat and agent-mode editing are available in JetBrains IDEs (github-copilot-docs-4, github-copilot-docs-24, github-copilot-docs-22), which implies some in-IDE diff/context capability, but no evidence specifically describes an interactive diff viewer or a 'share selected code as context' feature for JetBrains. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of JetBrains-specific interactive diff UI, explicit context-selection workflow, and independent/hands-on confirmation of these JetBrains features.
